national_questions.qe: How many Kirti Chakra awards were approved by the President of India on the eve of the 80th Independence Day 2026?

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is responsible for the 'Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets' in India?

national_questions.qe: What was the estimated cumulative value of India's merchandise exports during the period of April-July 2026-27?

national_questions.qe: Who has been appointed as the first Vice-Chancellor of the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation (AIPSI) in Mauritius?
national_questions.qh: मॉरीशस में अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ पब्लिक सर्विस एंड इनोवेशन (AIPSI) के पहले कुलपति के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Dr. Bhooma VG (IRPS Retd) has been selected as the Vice-Chancellor of the AIPSI, which was jointly inaugurated by the Prime Ministers of India and Mauritius in March 2025 to serve as a centre of excellence for the African region.
• Option A is Incorrect as he is the External Affairs Minister of India.
• Option C is Incorrect as he is the Prime Minister of Mauritius.
• Option D is Incorrect as he is not associated with this specific appointment.

national_questions.qe: As of the latest government data, how many Elephant Reserves are currently established across India?
national_questions.qh: नवीनतम सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार, वर्तमान में भारत में कुल कितने हाथी रिजर्व (Elephant Reserves) स्थापित हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India currently has 33 Elephant Reserves spread across 14 States, aimed at strengthening conservation through population monitoring and mitigating human-elephant conflict.
• Options A, B, and D are incorrect as they do not reflect the current official count of 33 reserves.

national_questions.qe: How many States and Union Territories in India have already notified cancer as a notifiable disease as per recent Supreme Court observations?
national_questions.qh: हालिया सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के अवलोकन के अनुसार, भारत के कितने राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों ने कैंसर को एक 'अधिसूचित रोग' (notifiable disease) घोषित कर दिया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because 17 out of 36 States and Union Territories have already notified cancer as a notifiable disease, while the Supreme Court has directed the remaining 19 to consider the same for better data collection and early detection.
• Options A, C, and D are incorrect based on the current status of 17 notified regions.

national_questions.qe: Which constitutional provision is sought to be amended by the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 to rename the state to 'Keralam'?
national_questions.qh: केरल (नाम परिवर्तन) विधेयक, 2026 द्वारा राज्य का नाम बदलकर 'केरलम' करने के लिए संविधान की किस अनुसूची में संशोधन का प्रस्ताव है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the First Schedule of the Constitution of India contains the list of States and Union Territories, and any change in the name of a state requires an amendment to this schedule.
• Option B is Incorrect as it deals with emoluments and salaries.
• Option C is Incorrect as it deals with forms of oaths or affirmations.
• Option D is Incorrect as it deals with the allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha.

national_questions.qe: MASHAV, which is involved in India-Israel development partnerships, is the official agency for international development cooperation of which country?
national_questions.qh: भारत-इजरायल विकास साझेदारी में शामिल 'माशव' (MASHAV) किस देश की आधिकारिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय विकास सहयोग एजेंसी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because MASHAV is Israel's Agency for International Development Cooperation, established to share Israel's expertise in agriculture, water management, and capacity building with other nations.
• Options A, B, and D are incorrect as MASHAV is exclusively an Israeli government agency.

national_questions.qe: Under the recent government notification, which two airports have been added to the list of international ports for e-visa holders?
national_questions.qh: हालिया सरकारी अधिसूचना के तहत, ई-वीजा धारकों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय बंदरगाहों की सूची में किन दो हवाई अड्डों को शामिल किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the government notified 11 new international ports for e-visa holders, which includes 9 land ports and 2 airports, specifically Bhopal and Tirupati.
• Options A, C, and D are incorrect as they were not part of this specific notification.

national_questions.qe: Which legislative category does the 'Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026' fall under, limiting the Rajya Sabha's power to only making recommendations?
national_questions.qh: 'कराधान और अन्य कानून (संशोधन) विधेयक, 2026' किस विधायी श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आता है, जो राज्यसभा की शक्ति को केवल सिफारिशें करने तक सीमित करता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill is classified as a Money Bill under Article 110 of the Constitution, meaning the Rajya Sabha cannot reject or amend it, only provide recommendations.
• Options A, B, and C are incorrect as they do not carry the same constitutional restrictions regarding the Rajya Sabha's powers.

bihar_questions.qe: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the four-laning of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) for which National Highway in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) ने हाइब्रिड एन्यूटी मॉडल (HAM) के तहत बिहार में किस राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के मुजफ्फरपुर-सीतामढ़ी-सोनबरसा खंड को चार लेन बनाने की मंजूरी दी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the CCEA approved the 82.58-km four-laning of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 in Bihar at a capital cost of Rs 3,590.73 crore under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM), serving as a crucial feeder corridor to the India-Nepal border.
• Option B is Incorrect because NH-27 is the East-West Corridor highway that connects with NH-22 at Muzaffarpur.
• Option C is Incorrect because NH-31 is a East-West trunk corridor in Bihar running along the Ganga basin.
• Option D is Incorrect because NH-102 connects Chhapra to Muzaffarpur.

bihar_questions.qe: Which four districts of the Seemanchal region in Bihar will primarily benefit from assured irrigation under the Kosi-Mechi Inter-State River Link Project?
bihar_questions.qh: 6,282 करोड़ रुपये की कोसी-मेची अंतर-राज्यीय नदी जोड़ो परियोजना से बिहार के सीमांचल क्षेत्र के कौन से चार जिले मुख्य रूप से लाभान्वित होंगे?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Rs 6,282.32-crore Kosi-Mechi River Link Project will divert surplus water from the Kosi River to the Mechi River to provide assured irrigation to 2,14,813 hectares across four Seemanchal districts: Araria, Purnea, Kishanganj, and Katihar.
• Option A is Incorrect because Supaul, Madhepura, Saharsa, and Khagaria constitute the core Kosi belt rather than the four beneficiary districts in the Mahananda basin reached by the link canal.
• Option B is Incorrect because Darbhanga, Madhubani, Samastipur, and Begusarai lie in central-north Bihar.
• Option D is Incorrect because Muzaffarpur, Vaishali, Saran, and Siwan belong to western and central Bihar regions.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which statutory provision was the Election Commission of India's authority to conduct Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar upheld by the Supreme Court?
bihar_questions.qh: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वारा बिहार में मतदाता सूची के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) का संचालन करने के लिए भारत निर्वाचन आयोग के किस वैधानिक प्रावधान के तहत अधिकार को बरकरार रखा गया?
oe: Section 21(3) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Supreme Court in Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India upheld the ECI's powers under Article 324 of the Constitution and Section 21(3) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 to order Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Passports Act, 1967 regulates travel documents and passport issuance.
• Option B is Incorrect because final citizenship determination falls under the Citizenship Act, 1955, whereas ECI's citizenship assessment during roll revision is prima facie in nature.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Delimitation Act, 2002 deals with readjustment of constituency boundaries.

bihar_questions.qe: How many Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations are being planned across 23 districts under the recent infrastructure initiative in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में हाल ही की बुनियादी ढांचा पहल के तहत 23 जिलों में कुल कितने इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन (EV) चार्जिंग स्टेशन स्थापित करने की योजना बनाई जा रही है?

• Option A is Incorrect as 105 is not the figure associated with this project.
• Option C is Incorrect as 145 does not match the surveyed number of stations.
• Option D is Incorrect because 160 is factually inaccurate for this state transport initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: What financial assistance has been granted to the Patna Metro project under the Central government's capital investment scheme?
bihar_questions.qh: केंद्र सरकार की पूंजीगत निवेश योजना के तहत पटना मेट्रो परियोजना को कितनी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Patna Metro has been granted Rs 628.32 crore under the Central government's capital investment scheme to accelerate ongoing corridor construction.
• Option A is Incorrect as the sanctioned amount is not 412.50 crore.

• Option D is Incorrect as 740.10 crore is an incorrect figure for this specific grant.

bihar_questions.qe: By which year is the infrastructure including road and water supply for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) slated for completion?
bihar_questions.qh: गया इंटीग्रेटेड मैन्युफैक्चरिंग क्लस्टर (IMC) के लिए सड़क और जल आपूर्ति सहित बुनियादी ढांचा किस वर्ष से पहले पूरा करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because infrastructure development, including road and water supply for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC), is slated for completion before 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect as 2026 is not the targeted deadline.
• Option C is Incorrect because the target precedes 2028.
• Option D is Incorrect as 2030 is beyond the official schedule announced for the project.

bihar_questions.qe: The newly sanctioned Sherghati-Kajree Broad Gauge Line Project, spanning Bihar and Jharkhand, falls under which railway zone?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार और झारखंड में फैली हाल ही में स्वीकृत शेरघाटी-कजरा नई ब्रॉड गेज लाइन परियोजना किस रेलवे ज़ोन के अंतर्गत आती है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project spanning Bihar and Jharkhand is sanctioned under the East Central Railway (ECR) zone at an estimated cost of Rs 26.27 billion.
• Option A is Incorrect as it does not fall under Northern Railway.
• Option B is Incorrect as Northeast Frontier Railway does not manage this route.
• Option D is Incorrect because Eastern Railway is not the designated zone for this specific project.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the primary target set by the Bihar government regarding the allocation of surveyed mineral blocks following the recent strategic mineral block auctions inaugurated in Patna?
bihar_questions.qh: पटना में हाल ही में उद्घाटित रणनीतिक खनिज ब्लॉक नीलामियों के बाद, सर्वेक्षित खनिज ब्लॉकों के आवंटन को लेकर बिहार सरकार द्वारा क्या मुख्य लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया गया है?
oe: To allocate over 30 out of 44 surveyed mineral blocks before September 30
To allocate all 44 mineral blocks exclusively for private foreign corporations by August 15
To restrict mining operations entirely to the Rohtas district until 2030
To auction only coal blocks while omitting limestone and other minor minerals
oh: 30 सितंबर से पहले 44 सर्वेक्षित खनिज ब्लॉकों में से 30 से अधिक का आवंटन करना
15 अगस्त तक सभी 44 खनिज ब्लॉकों को विशेष रूप से निजी विदेशी निगमों को आवंटित करना
2030 तक खनन गतिविधियों को पूरी तरह से रोहतास जिले तक सीमित रखना
चूना पत्थर और अन्य लघु खنيजों को छोड़कर केवल कोयला ब्लॉकों की नीलामी करना
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar government, during the inauguration of strategic mineral block auctions and the National Mineral Exploration Trust (NMET) workshop in Patna, set a target to allocate over 30 out of 44 surveyed mineral blocks before September 30, with mining operations scheduled to start by October 15. Key mineral districts include Rohtas, Aurangabad, Jamui, and Gaya.
• Option B is Incorrect because foreign corporations are not given exclusive rights, and the target timeline is September 30.
• Option C is Incorrect because mining covers multiple districts such as Aurangabad, Jamui, Banka, and Bhagalpur, not just Rohtas.
• Option D is Incorrect because limestone, coal, and other strategic minerals are included in the comprehensive mineral block framework.

bihar_questions.qe: Which new broad gauge railway line project was sanctioned by the Ministry of Railways connecting Sherghati in Bihar to Kajree in Jharkhand with an estimated cost of Rs 26.27 billion?
bihar_questions.qh: रेल मंत्रालय द्वारा बिहार के शेरघाटी को झारखंड के कजरी से जोड़ने वाली किस नई ब्रॉड गेज रेलवे लाइन परियोजना को 26.27 बिलियन रुपये की अनुमानित लागत के साथ स्वीकृत किया गया है?
oe: Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project
oh: शेरघाटी-कजरी न्यू ब्रॉड गेज लाइन प्रोजेक्ट
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of Railways sanctioned the Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project with an estimated cost of Rs 26.27 billion, involving a 107.89 km long new line connecting Sherghati (Bihar) to Kajree (Jharkhand) under the East Central Railway (ECR) zone.
• Option A is Incorrect because Patna-Ranchi is served by different existing routes like Vande Bharat, not this specific newly sanctioned project.
• Option B is Incorrect as no such newly sanctioned project under this exact name and scope exists in the recent railway announcements.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bhagalpur-Deoghar is not the corridor sanctioned under the Rs 26.27 billion Sherghati-Kajree project.

bihar_questions.qe: In which district of Bihar did the state cabinet approve two major sugar mill and distillery projects with a combined investment of Rs 422.5 crore?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार मंत्रिमंडल ने किस जिले में 422.5 करोड़ रुपये के कुल निवेश के साथ दो प्रमुख चीनी मिल और डिस्टिलरी परियोजनाओं को मंजूरी दी है?

• Option A is Incorrect because the project is located in East Champaran, not West Champaran.
• Option C is Incorrect as Muzaffarpur was not the site for these specific sugar mill investments.
• Option D is Incorrect because Darbhanga is not associated with this cabinet-approved sugar mill and distillery investment.

bihar_questions.qe: How much financial funding was recently secured by the Patna Metro project under the Central government's capital investment scheme to accelerate its construction corridors?
bihar_questions.qh: केंद्र सरकार की पूंजी निवेश योजना के तहत पटना मेट्रो परियोजना को अपने निर्माण गलियारों में तेजी लाने के लिए हाल ही में कितनी वित्तीय राशि प्राप्त हुई है?

• Option C is Correct because the Patna Metro secured INR 628.32 crore under the Central government's capital investment scheme, which helps accelerate construction work across its various corridors as part of the central push for urban infrastructure development in Bihar.
• Option A is Incorrect as it does not match the allocated funding figure.
• Option B is Incorrect as the sanctioned capital investment amount is INR 628.32 crore.
• Option D is Incorrect because INR 950.00 crore is an arbitrary figure not associated with this central capital investment grant.

bihar_questions.qe: The newly sanctioned Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project connects the state of Bihar with which neighboring state?
bihar_questions.qh: हाल ही में स्वीकृत शेरघाटी-कजरी नई ब्रॉड गेज लाइन परियोजना बिहार राज्य को किस पड़ोसी राज्य से जोड़ती है?

bihar_questions.qh: बिहार मंत्रिमंडल ने हाल ही में 422.5 करोड़ रुपये की दो प्रमुख चीनी मिल और डिस्टिलरी परियोजनाओं को बिहार के किस जिले में मंजूरी दी है?

bihar_questions.qe: Which mineral-rich district in Bihar is specifically noted for limestone deposits as part of the state's upcoming mining operations set to resume in October 2026?
bihar_questions.qh: अक्टूबर 2026 में शुरू होने वाले खनन कार्यों के तहत बिहार के किस खनिज-समृद्ध जिले को विशेष रूप से चूना पत्थर (लाइमस्टोन) के भंडारों के लिए चिह्नित किया गया है?

• Option C is Incorrect because Banka is not the primary district cited for limestone reserves in this announcement.

bihar_questions.qe: Which district holds the first rank in Bihar for the highest number of farmers issued with Sugarcane IDs under the state's sugarcane expansion campaign?
bihar_questions.qh: राज्य के गन्ने के विस्तार अभियान के तहत किसानों को गन्ना आईडी (Sugarcane IDs) जारी करने के मामले में बिहार में कौन सा जिला प्रथम स्थान पर है?

• Option A is Incorrect because Darbhanga ranks second, not first, in the state.
• Option B is Incorrect as Muzaffarpur is not the leading district for sugarcane ID registrations.
• Option D is Incorrect because Patna is not among the top ranked districts for sugarcane cultivation metrics in this campaign.

bihar_questions.qe: Which central agencies have initiated direct procurement of masoor dal from farmers in Bihar under the Centre's direct pulse procurement network for the first time?
bihar_questions.qh: केंद्र सरकार के प्रत्यक्ष दलहन खरीद नेटवर्क के तहत पहली बार बिहार के किसानों से किस केंद्रीय एजेंसी द्वारा मसूर दाल की सीधी खरीद शुरू की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because NCCF (National Cooperative Consumers' Federation of India) and Nafed (National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India) have procured masoor directly from Bihar farmers at the Minimum Support Price (MSP).

• Option C is Incorrect because NABARD functions primarily as a development bank rather than a direct procurement agency for pulses here.
• Option D is Incorrect because STC and MMTC deal with international trade and minerals, not state agricultural procurement.

bihar_questions.qe: Which central agencies procured masoor directly from farmers under Bihar's maiden entry into the Centre's direct pulse procurement network?
bihar_questions.qh: केंद्र के प्रत्यक्ष दलहन खरीद नेटवर्क में बिहार के पहली बार शामिल होने के तहत किन केंद्रीय एजेंसियों ने किसानों से सीधे मसूर की खरीद की?

• Option A is Incorrect because FCI and TRIFED were not the procuring agencies for this specific pulse network initiative.
• Option C is Incorrect because NABARD is a development bank and not a direct commercial procurement agency for pulses here.
